<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en"> <head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><meta name="theme-color" content="#FBFAF7"><!--
  Set the light/dark class on <html> BEFORE first paint, so a dark-mode visitor
  never flashes the light theme on load. Inline vanilla JS with no imports so it
  runs synchronously ahead of any bundle. The storage key + resolution rule
  mirror ThemeToggle.astro â keep the two in sync.
--><script>
  (function () {
    try {
      var pref = localStorage.getItem("composo.theme");
      if (pref !== "light" && pref !== "dark" && pref !== "system") {
        pref = "system";
      }
      var dark = pref === "dark" || (pref === "system" && window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches);
      var root = document.documentElement;
      root.setAttribute("data-theme-pref", pref);
      root.classList.toggle("dark", dark);
      root.style.colorScheme = dark ? "dark" : "light";
      var meta = document.querySelector('meta[name="theme-color"]');
      if (meta) meta.setAttribute("content", dark ? "#1c1813" : "#FBFAF7");
    } catch (e) {}
  })();
</script><link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="/favicon.svg"><link rel="icon" type="image/x-icon" href="/favicon.ico"><link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="/images/composo-square.png"><link rel="canonical" href="https://www.composo.ai/blog/"><title>Blog | Composo</title><meta name="description" content="Technical articles on AI evaluation, LLM judges, RAG evals, agent testing, and more."><meta property="og:type" content="website"><meta property="og:url" content="https://www.composo.ai/blog/"><meta property="og:title" content="Blog | Composo"><meta property="og:description" content="Technical articles on AI evaluation, LLM judges, RAG evals, agent testing, and more."><meta property="og:image" content="https://www.composo.ai/images/og/home.png"><meta property="og:image:width" content="1200"><meta property="og:image:height" content="630"><meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_ima
